Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Complete the cohort to fifteen participants through the continuing open call with the FAIR Coalition's backing and collect signed commitments.

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Collect each participant's dataset and a short data description.
Research Question: What types of research data does a mixed ETH cohort hold and which of them raise the hardest sharing questions?

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Run a baseline survey of each participant's RDM and RSE experience and competencies.
Research Question: Where do ETH researchers who already carry RDM responsibility stand at the start of the programme?

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Set up the ETH GitLab and GitHub spaces and the Matrix (Element) support channel.

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Finalise and publish the workshop schedule and confirm venues including the two Villa Hatt bookings.

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Divide the cohort between the two applicants for direct data support, so each participant has a named contact for their own dataset.
Lead: Lars Schöbitz and Adriana Clavijo Daza

Name: Setup and recruitment
Project Activity: Sign the FAIR Coalition Charter and confirm the Data Stewardship Network link.

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Workshop 1, month 3: Git for Scientists. Four hours on Git and GitHub or GitLab collaborative workflows, building on the existing Git for Scientists material. Adriana Clavijo Daza supports in person and on the technical side.

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Workshop 2, month 4: FAIR data sharing. Four hours built on the openwashdata workflow, working with each participant's own data. Adriana Clavijo Daza supports in person and on the technical side.
Research Question: How does FAIR data sharing practice differ between the disciplines and data types in the cohort?

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Workshop 3, month 5: GitHub for project and task management. Four hours on GitHub or GitLab for tracking research work. Adriana Clavijo Daza supports in person and on the technical side.

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Workshop 4, month 6: Agentic AI. Eight hours on agentic AI workflows for data management, held at Villa Hatt. Adriana Clavijo Daza supports in person and on the technical side.
Research Question: How do researchers declare AI use in a way that shows what they still produced themselves?

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Host the full-day organisational change for open science workshop at Villa Hatt, month 8, delivered by Greg Wilson. The applicants participate and host rather than teach.
Research Question: What organisational change methods work for embedding FAIR practice in an ETH research group?
Lead: Greg Wilson (hosted by Lars Schöbitz and Adriana Clavijo Daza)

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Workshop 5, month 9: FAIR data management and data management strategy. Four hours taking each participant from a documented dataset to a data management strategy for their own group. Adriana Clavijo Daza hosts selected modules.
Lead: Lars Schöbitz and Adriana Clavijo Daza

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Project Activity: Run the support hours between workshops and take each participant's dataset through the data-package pipeline to a citable release with a DOI. The cohort is split between the two applicants, each supporting their own participants' data directly.
Lead: Lars Schöbitz and Adriana Clavijo Daza

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Run the day-to-day support channels: the Matrix (Element) channel, 1:1 questions and calls, and direct support on each participant's own data.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Run the quarterly two-hour hands-on project team meetings.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Host AI Playground sessions three times per term from spring semester 2027 and open them to anyone at ETH and to the general public.
Lead: Lars Schöbitz and Adriana Clavijo Daza

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Publish the programme's material and progress on a public project website, including the Open Educational Resources as they are produced.

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Share progress and findings through blog posts and social media channels, primarily LinkedIn, to reach researchers beyond ETH.
Lead: Lars Schöbitz and Adriana Clavijo Daza

Name: Community building and outreach
Project Activity: Present the programme and its interim findings at reproducibility and RDM venues and through the Data Stewardship Network and RSE Network.

Name: Consolidation, sustainability, and reporting
Project Activity: Publish the final FAIR data packages with DOIs, citation files with ORCIDs, and entries in the ETH Research Collection.
Lead: Lars Schöbitz and Adriana Clavijo Daza

Name: Consolidation, sustainability, and reporting
Project Activity: Capture the programme as a reusable offering and publish all teaching material as Open Educational Resources including the delivery handbooks.

Name: Consolidation, sustainability, and reporting
Project Activity: Write up the community comparison and the AI-declaration recommendations, and submit the final content and financial reports.
Research Question: How do FAIR data sharing, data security, and the declaration of AI use differ between the communities in the cohort?
